selection_rationale: A synthetic incident review needs threat triage, source inspection, safe remediation planning, and server-configuration assessment in that order.

selected_skills.rationale: Establish incident priorities and credential/host safety constraints before technical changes.
Inspect the supplied source and identify vulnerabilities without executing the fixture.
Propose a minimal remediation and regression tests based on the audit findings.
Assess service configuration and propose hardening after application-level findings are known.
